latestVersion.changelog:
Video Maker Guru Free 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly create and edit videos by just describing your desired outcome; no editing skills or paid software required.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; processes in the cloud and outputs polished 1080p MP4s within 1-2 minutes.
- Handles automatic session setup, anonymous authentication, and free credits for new users.
- Interactive workflow: upload, edit, preview, and export videos with simple chat instructions.
- Provides clear status updates and error handling for file type, size, credits, and export issues.
